t: 9 Supplements Your Gut Will Thank You For
s: October 19, 2025 - L-glutamine helps heal and protect the intestines' lining and balances the gut microbiome. Glutamine-rich foods include vegetables and animal proteins. L-glutamine supplements, available in capsule and powder form, are a convenient way to get enough of the amino acid. While there is no standardized recommendation for glutamine supplements, studies have found that a dose of 0.9 grams per kilogram of fat-free body mass is generally well tolerated. A healthcare provider can help you incorporate glutamine supplements safely.
